source_text: Omnis qui est spontanei cordis offerat. Non coactio; voluntas. Deus amat hilarem datorem. Aurum fidei, argentum eloquii, aes patientiae.
pass_a_gloss: Every who is of-willing heart let-him-offer. Not coercion; will. God loves cheerful giver. Gold of-faith, silver of-speech, bronze of-patience.
pass_b_english: [[Everyone of a willing heart shall offer >> Bible:Exodus 35:5]]. Not coercion — will. [[God loves a cheerful giver >> Bible:2 Corinthians 9:7]]. Gold of faith, silver of speech, bronze of patience.
